(This specific threshold was introduced by the Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2021, replacing the earlier vaguer "statutory limit" language.) question: Explain the doctrine of Res Sub-Judice under the CPC and state its essential conditions.
gold_answer: Answer Details: Section 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, governs the stay of suits (Res Sub-Judice). The suits must be between the same parties or their litigating representatives. 4. The court where the previous suit is pending must have jurisdiction to grant the relief claimed. 5. Both parties must be litigating under the same title. Reference: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, s. 10.
